senses.gloss:
ITA-1.9.3.3.33 darpaḥ दर्पः
Pride
A condition of arrogance, haughtiness, insolence or conceit.

ITA-5.13.5 kaphajakṛmiḥ कफजकृमिः [अन्त्रादः, उदरादः, हृदयचरः, चुरवः, दर्भपुष्पः, सौगन्धिकः, महागुदा]
Worm or parasite arising from vitiated kapha; residing in stomach and small intestine
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: loss of taste; indigestion; borborygmi with distension; salivation; emaciation; sneezing; vomiting; fever; cold catarrh; syncope or swooning; nausea; yawning; generalized body aches; roughness/dryness.

ITA-7.1.3.5 darvikayantram दर्विकयन्त्रम्
Ladle-shaped instrument
darvikayantram

ITA-9.6.35 dāraṇakarma दारणकर्म
Splitting, tearing or lancing
A procedure for removing pus from an abscess.

ITA-9.6.134 dāraṇakarma दारणकर्म
Therapeutic rupturing, tearing
Induction of rupturing or tearing by local application of drugs.

ITA-9.6.207 dāraṇakarma दारणकर्म
Removal of foreign body by splitting or tearing
The removal of a loosely impacted foreign body by splitting or tearing after application of a medication to the wound.

ITA-5.62.26 dāruṇakaḥ दारुणकः
Dandruff
A disorder characterized by itching of scalp; hair loss; loss of tactile sensation; dry scalp; cracks in scalp; hardening of scalp; cracked scalp skin; dry hairs.

ITA-9.6.156 dāruṇakarma दारुणकर्म
Hardening-promoting measures for wound management
Technique of wound bed preparation for better healing by hardening of loose granulation tissue.

ITA-5.76.70 dāruṇakoṣṭhavirecanavyāpat दारुणकोष्ठ-विरेचनव्यापत्
Condition caused by purgation therapy administered to person with costive bowel habit
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: pain in precordium/cardiac region; breaking type of pain in small joints; borborygmi with distension; generalized body aches; vomiting; syncope or swooning; exhaustion without exertion; death of the patient.

ITA-2.1.3.9 dārḍhyam दार्ढ्यम्
Firmness
A normal function of kapha. It signifies hardness, fixedness, stability and strength.
